name: Earthquakes & tsunami
summary: M6.8 off Timor-Leste on 21 Nov was the largest quake in seven days; no M7+ or PAGER orange alert
state: USGS recorded four M6+ earthquakes in the seven days to 27 Nov, the largest an M6.8 north-east of Lospalos, Timor-Leste, on 21 Nov, rated PAGER green; an M6.4 struck the Mauritius–Réunion region on 24 Nov. The highest PAGER level was yellow, for an M5.9 south-west of Yanglong, China, on 21 Nov (USGS). With no M7+ or PAGER orange alert in seven days, Normal holds.
for_you: No major earthquake emergency. Travellers in quake zones can follow local authority and FCDO advice.
rubric_hit: max magnitude 6.8 below the 7 Watch line

sources.title: USGS — M6.8, 105 km NE of Lospalos, Timor-Leste
USGS — M5.9, 238 km SW of Yanglong, China

why: Large earthquakes can kill thousands in seconds and disrupt global supply chains (chips, cars).
drivers: Tectonics — unpredictable; impact depends on depth, location and building standards.

rubric.alert: PAGER red, or a tsunami causing damage.
rubric.watch: M7+ in the past 7 days, or PAGER orange, or a tsunami warning issued.
rubric.normal: No USGS PAGER orange/red alert and no M7+ in the past 7 days.
